query:
SELECT 
  s.id, 
  s.saleDate,
  DATE(s.saleDate) as saleDateOnly,
  s.status,
  si.productId,
  p.name as productName,
  si.quantity,
  si.totalPrice
FROM sales s
INNER JOIN saleItems si ON s.id = si.saleId
INNER JOIN products p ON si.productId = p.id
WHERE p.name LIKE '%Baly%Maça%Verde%'
  AND s.saleDate >= '2025-12-01'
  AND s.saleDate <= '2025-12-31'
  AND s.status != 'CANCELLED'
ORDER BY s.saleDate;
